C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.Name: Forward-only public repository hygiene — implementation plan
C-PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-HYGIENE.IntentSummary: Apply the owner-approved forward-only cleanup in a clean worktree: canonicalize public policy, split the deterministic gate from private workstation review, retire obsolete current-state process projections, remove only the exact obsolete artifacts, and neutralize live QA attribution without touching history or release evidence.

MustPassCommand.Command: npx vitest run tests/renderer/i18n/index.test.js tests/renderer/muya/htmlTagBr.test.js tests/renderer/platform-truth.test.js tests/renderer/store/preferences.test.ts

sh -c 'git diff --check fork/main && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | while IFS= read -r candidate_path; do output=$(git diff --no-index --check /dev/null "$candidate_path" 2>&1); result=$?; test "$result" -le 1 || exit "$result"; test -z "$output" || { printf "%s\n" "$output"; exit 1; }; done'

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AGENTS.md is a short neutral router; CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/engineering-protocol.md contain the portable language, GRACE, markup, verification, release-boundary and modification rules; docs/release-process.md preserves the exact release runbook without workstation-specific inference instructions.

The approved QA, handoff, methodology and generated screenshot paths are absent; exact ignores prevent reintroduction; CLAUDE.md and .env.local stay local-only; authored work and release screenshots remain; publication-privacy tests pin all boundaries.

The public gate retains exact candidates, Gitleaks, static exposure/binary/lane/ref checks, candidate identity recheck and private deterministic receipts while removing prompts, GPU/model endpoints and override logic.

The portable policy survives in docs/engineering-protocol.md; Phase-H, M-901..M-906, V-M-901..V-M-906, DF-901..DF-903 and their current crosslinks are removed; frozen provenance and archived bundles are unchanged.
Live source, tests and current verification describe regression evidence without personal or workstation-specific attribution; archived C-15 evidence remains byte-identical.
